sites.name: Star Tech
sites.note: iPhones sold with BTRC-approved one-year Apple warranty (official). iPhone 16/16e/16 Plus/16 Pro/16 Pro Max/15/15 Pro pages show 'To be announced' (no offer); iPhone 15 Plus and 15 Pro Max priced. Struck price used as oldPrice. Used as specsSource.

sites.name: Gadget & Gear
sites.note: Apple authorised reseller, official. Cash price = discountedPrice in page data. iPhone 16 Plus/16 Pro/16 Pro Max/16e/14 pages used; all 16-series are Stock Out, iPhone 14 128GB in stock. iPhone 15-series and the iPhone 16 Pro 1TB page are not used as offers because the worker reads an accessory price from them, but their page-data regular prices are used as officialPrice.

sites.name: Apple Gadgets
sites.note: Unofficial imports; per-variant price/status with region options. 'Just Active' (activated) and 'Apple Certified Refurbished' options excluded; 'Inactive'/'Regular' = new. Separate '-0fficial' iPhone 15 Pro page (official, stock out).

sites.name: Sumash Tech
sites.note: Separate '-official' pages (official) and international pages (region per variant). Official pages carry no discount (price = MRP). iPhone Duo listing only shows a 10,000 booking amount, skipped.

sites.name: Kry International
sites.note: Unofficial pages with region per variant (USA, JAPAN, AUS, GLOBAL, Hong Kong, Singapore, Canada, UK, IND) plus '-official' pages. iPhone Duo listing is a 20,000 booking price, skipped.

sites.name: Executive Machines
sites.note: Apple Authorised Reseller, one page per storage, official warranty; widest official coverage incl. iPhone Duo and 2TB models; iPad mini and some iPad configs not listed.

sites.name: Diamu
sites.note: WooCommerce, unofficial, per-variant region prices. Only iPhone 16 Plus and 16 Pro Max have prices; 15-series, 16 Pro and 16e pages are out of stock with no price.

sites.name: Dazzle
sites.note: Unofficial regional variants (JP/MEA, SG/AUS/TH, USA, HK/CH) in page data; only active, non-TBA variants used. MRP shown is inflated. Some variant data looks wrong (17 Pro Max 2TB cheaper than 1TB) and was skipped. iPhone Duo is a 10,000 booking only; no 17e/16e prices.

sites.name: Mobile Buzz BD
sites.note: WooCommerce; per-option price and stock. Only the iPhone 16e page has storage options (with region); other older-iPhone pages show one price without a storage, so they are skipped (iPhone 15 page shows a 10,000 placeholder).

sites.name: CustomMacBD
sites.note: Shopify, unofficial imports 'with Apple International Warranty claim support'; per-variant price with SIM/region options (1 SIM + eSIM by country, USA dual eSIM, HK/CH dual physical SIM). Most older-iPhone options are sold out but keep a listed price. A few sold-out options look stale (iPhone 14 256GB SG cheaper than 128GB, iPhone 16 Plus 512GB cheaper than 256GB) and were skipped.

sites.name: iStockBD
sites.note: Shopify, unofficial new stock; per-storage price (colors same price), region only on some pages (iPhone 14: Global/USA/HK). Out-of-stock options priced 0 skipped (iPhone 15 512GB).

sites.name: MacZen BD
sites.note: Next.js shop, unofficial; iPhone pages list storage/SIM combinations but only the priced ones (usually base storage) are used.

sites.name: PCB Store
sites.note: PC/gadget store with a few colour-and-storage-specific iPhone listings (stock out, page price kept); importer channel, treated unofficial.
